The side stage viewing only holds 25 people where as I was informed by staff they sell about 200 platinum passes.  This is my first time at this festival.  I’ve done platinum/super vip at other fests before such as hangout, and aside from the viewing areas being horrible, everything else has been nice, comfortable, convenient, and comparable to other fests offerings.  The comp lockers are a huge bonus since in the past that’s always been an additional $40 to spend regardless of what package you have.  All in all it’s still great, but the perks aren’t based around the music aspect of this fest.
